writing.issue.subject_verb_agreement: Ega va kesim moslashmagan - masalan 'he go' emas, 'he goes' bo'lishi kerak.
writing.issue.missing_article: Artikl tushib qolgan - sanaladigan ot oldida 'a/an' yoki 'the' kerak.
writing.issue.wrong_preposition: Predlog noto'g'ri tanlangan - vaqt/joy uchun mos predlogni tekshiring (in/on/at).
writing.issue.verb_tense: Fe'l zamoni mos emas - gap mazmuniga qarab to'g'ri zamonni tanlang.
writing.issue.gerund_infinitive: Fe'ldan keyin noto'g'ri shakl - ba'zi fe'llar -ing, ba'zilari 'to' + fe'l talab qiladi.
writing.issue.word_choice: So'z tanlovi noaniq yoki takrorlanyapti - boyroq yoki aniqroq so'z ishlating.
writing.issue.off_topic: Bu qism topshiriq mavzusidan chetga chiqqan - savolga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob bering.
writing.issue.weak_coherence: Fikrlar yetarlicha bog'lanmagan - bog'lovchi so'zlar (however, because, for example) qo'shing.
writing.issue.too_short: Matn topshiriq uchun juda qisqa - fikringizni misollar bilan kengaytiring.
writing.issue.not_english: Bu matn ingliz tilidagi javobga o'xshamaydi - topshiriqqa to'liq, mazmunli ingliz tilida javob yozing.
